description: This PHP file provides a web interface for resetting and restoring a network gateway device. It includes HTML content, embedded JavaScript for user interactions (confirmation dialogs, AJAX requests), and PHP includes for header, footer, and navigation components.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to initiate a reset or restore action on the gateway, showing progress indicators, handling reboots, Wi-Fi restarts, and redirecting upon completion.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Periodically checks if the device has rebooted by attempting to access index.php, and redirects to login if successful.
